hints.namePattern: Letters, digits, and . _ / : - only, 1 to 128 characters
hints.slotMissing: Slot {{slot}} is declared but its placeholder is missing from the text
hints.slotUndeclared: Slot {{slot}} is present in the text but not declared
hints.toolsRule: {{min}} to {{max}} unique tools from the allowlist ({{count}} chosen)
hints.versionProposed: Proposed: the next patch version above the highest registered version
hints.versionFormat: A SemVer 2.0.0 version without build metadata, for example 0.1.0
hints.dimensionNotice: Weights of dimensions that the chosen dimension set does not contain were dropped: {{ids}}
hints.coachDimensionSetMajor: Listed first: matches the dimension set major version {{major}} of the prompt template
hints.hintsDoNotBlock: Hints do not block submission. The platform validates the record.

violations.title: The platform refused the registration
violations.schema-violation: The record does not match its format: {{detail}}
violations.unknown-tool: The tool {{detail}} is not on the tool allowlist.
violations.tool-outside-baseline: The tool {{detail}} is outside the permitted-tool baseline of this agent.
violations.unknown-agent-id: The agent identifier is not part of the catalog baseline.
violations.group-mismatch: The group does not match the agent or the referenced artifact.
violations.artifact-not-found: The referenced artifact is not registered.
violations.artifact-kind-mismatch: The referenced artifact is of another kind than this reference requires.
violations.missing-dimension: A dimension of the dimension set has no weight row.
violations.unknown-dimension: A weight row names a dimension that the dimension set does not contain.
violations.weight-out-of-range: A weight must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
violations.rationale-missing: Every weight needs a rationale and a provenance statement.
violations.dimension-set-not-found: The dimension set version is not registered.
violations.dimension-set-incompatible: The dimension set does not match the major version the prompt template requires.
violations.dimension-set-ids-changed: A new minor version of a dimension set must keep the identifiers of the dimensions.
violations.modifier-bound-exceeded: The per-dimension bound or the total positive movement exceeds the allowed bounds.
violations.modifier-movement-exceeded: The total positive movement exceeds the allowed bounds.
violations.context-category-not-permitted: This context category is not permitted.
violations.profile-slot-missing: The prompt template of a Coach Agent must declare and use the philosophy profile slot.
violations.profile-slot-not-allowed: Only the prompt template of a Coach Agent may use the philosophy profile slot.
violations.disclosure-missing: A Coach Agent version needs a simulation disclosure statement of 20 to 1,000 characters.
violations.safety-rule-missing: The safety policy lacks a rule that this group requires.
violations.superseded-profile-invalid: The superseded profile version is not a registered version of this profile.
violations.provider-not-permitted: This provider is not permitted in this environment.

refusals.title: The platform refused the change
refusals.agent-catalog-version-exists: This identifier and version are already registered with different content: registered versions never change; register a new version.
refusals.agent-version-not-draft: Only a draft agent version can be approved.
refusals.differentiation-review-required: This version has profile distances below 0.10: acknowledge the differentiation review to approve it.
refusals.agent-version-not-approved: Only an approved agent version can be retired.
refusals.agent-version-enabled: This version is enabled: enable another version or disable the agent first.
refusals.coach-agent-enablement-unsupported: The platform does not support enabling Coach Agents yet.
refusals.agent-not-found: The platform does not know this agent.

enablementReasons.simulated-provider: The version uses the simulated provider, which is permitted only in Development and Test.

outcomes.replayed: Already registered, nothing changed. The stored record is shown.
outcomes.changed: This record has changed since you loaded it. The current state is shown; decide again.

approve.title: Approve version {{version}} of {{agentId}}
approve.accountable: An approval records an accountable decision. It is not evaluation evidence.
approve.selfApproval: You registered this version. The approval is recorded as a self-approval.
approve.acknowledgement: I have reviewed the differentiation of these profiles

retire.title: Retire version {{version}} of {{agentId}}
retire.effect: A retired version can no longer be enabled. Invocations that pinned it keep it.

enablement.title: Change the enabled version of {{agentId}}
enablement.nextNone: New enabled version: none (the agent is disabled)
enablement.effect: Only questions submitted afterwards use the change. Existing invocations, their retries, and their history keep their pinned versions.
enablement.disableEffect: Members can no longer add or ask the agent until a version is enabled again.
enablement.coachNote: This is a Coach Agent version. The platform may refuse while Coach Agents are not available in conversations.
enablement.done: The enablement was changed. Only questions submitted afterwards use it.
